name: Clozapine
effects: Treatment-resistant schizophrenia gold standard — requires REMS/ANC monitoring
Agranulocytosis risk (~1–2%): mandatory weekly→biweekly→monthly ANC monitoring
No EPS or tardive dyskinesia — lowest D2 affinity of any antipsychotic
Greatest metabolic burden: weight gain, diabetes, myocarditis risk
Strong sedation, hypersalivation, seizure risk (dose-dependent above 600 mg)
Reduces suicidality in schizophrenia — FDA-approved for this indication
Multiple serious interactions; mandatory dispensing through REMS program
